ruleDefinitions.name: Copy From Or To Admin Share Or Sysvol Folder
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a copy command or a copy utility execution to or from an Admin share or remote

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\\\\\*\\$.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Sysvol\\\\.*")) AND (((process_path = RGX("\\\\robocopy\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\xcopy\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "robocopy\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "XCOPY\.EXE")) OR ((process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "Cmd\.Exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*copy.*")) OR (((process_path = RGX(".*\\\\powershell\\\.exe.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\pwsh\\\.exe.*")) OR (process_original_file_name = "PowerShell\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "pwsh\.dll")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*copy\\-item.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*copy\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cpi\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ cp\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*move\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*move\\-item.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ mi\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ mv\\ .*"))))
